images.prompt: Vertical epic cinematic film still, photorealistic, anamorphic lens, dramatic volumetric light, deep rich color grade, fine film grain, shallow depth of field. A single long smooth serpentine groove, one continuous flowing S-curve line left by a slithering snake, winds across the clean sand toward the horizon; a small sand-colored snake is visible at the far end of the curve. Warm gold grade, long shadows. Upper third of the frame is soft sky or calm dark negative space. No people, no footprints, no tire tracks, no hands, no text, letters or watermarks.
